name: Minecraft Java
author: aetheris-project
description: Minecraft Java Edition server (Paper, Purpur, Fabric or Vanilla) with automatic version resolution, EULA acceptance and configurable memory presets.

installation.script:
# @author Aetheris Project
# @description Minecraft Java install script with version + build resolution
# @user-alpine
# @user-ubuntu

apt-get update -y
apt-get install -y curl unzip jq

if [ -z "${SERVER_JARFILE}" ]; then
  SERVER_JARFILE=server.jar
fi

case ${MINECRAFT_VERSION} in
  vanilla)
    LATEST=$(curl -s https://launchermeta.mojang.com/mc/game/version_manifest_v2.json | jq -r .latest.release)
    VERSION=${MC_VERSION:-$LATEST}
    DOWNLOAD_URL=$(curl -s https://launchermeta.mojang.com/mc/game/version_manifest_v2.json | jq -r --arg v "$VERSION" '.versions[] | select(.id==$v) | .url')
    curl -s "$DOWNLOAD_URL" | jq -r .downloads.server.url | xargs curl -s -o "${SERVER_JARFILE}"
    ;;
  paper)
    VERSION=${MC_VERSION:-latest}
    API=https://api.papermc.io/v2/projects/paper/versions/${VERSION}
    BUILD=$(curl -s ${API}/builds | jq -r '.builds[-1].build')
    curl -s -o "${SERVER_JARFILE}" ${API}/builds/${BUILD}/downloads/paper-${VERSION}-${BUILD}.jar
    ;;
  purpur)
    VERSION=${MC_VERSION:-latest}
    curl -s -o "${SERVER_JARFILE}" https://api.purpurmc.org/v2/purpur/${VERSION}/latest/download
    ;;
  fabric)
    VERSION=${MC_VERSION:-latest}
    LOADER=$(curl -s https://meta.fabricmc.net/v2/versions/loader | jq -r '.[0].loader.version')
    INSTALLER=$(curl -s https://meta.fabricmc.net/v2/versions/installer | jq -r '.[0].version')
    curl -s -o fabric-installer.jar https://meta.fabricmc.net/v2/versions/loader/${VERSION}/${LOADER}/${INSTALLER}/server/jar
    java -jar fabric-installer.jar server -mcversion ${VERSION} -loader ${LOADER} -downloadMinecraft
    mv server.jar "${SERVER_JARFILE}"
    rm -f fabric-installer.jar
    ;;
  *)
    echo "Unknown server type: ${SERVER_TYPE}. Supported: vanilla, paper, purpur, fabric."
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

# EULA
if [ "${ACCEPT_EULA}" == "1" ]; then
  echo "eula=true" > eula.txt
else
  echo "eula=false" > eula.txt
fi

# Default properties when absent
if [ ! -f server.properties ]; then
  cat > server.properties <<EOF
motd=${MOTD:-Aetheris Minecraft Server}
max-players=${MAX_PLAYERS:-20}
server-port=${SERVER_PORT:-25565}
online-mode=${ONLINE_MODE:-true}
EOF
fi

variables.name: Minecraft Version
variables.description: The Minecraft version to install (e.g. 1.21.4, latest).

variables.name: Server Type
variables.description: Distribution: vanilla, paper, purpur or fabric.

variables.name: Memory (MB)
variables.description: Amount of memory in MB allocated to the server.

variables.name: Server Port
variables.description: The port the server listens on.

variables.name: MOTD
variables.description: Server description shown in the server list.
